description: 'Momentum Strategies in Commodity Futures Markets' found buying the best 12-month performers among commodities beats buying the worst. Approximation: commodity ETFs, top 4 by 12-1 month return. Falsified if it does not beat an equal-weight commodity basket.
title: Commodity momentum 12-1 · top 4 of 13 commodity ETFs (after Miffre & Rallis 2007)
